_readme: Where each track is TAUGHT in Skool. Riff only holds the assessment, so
finishing a Riff track has to hand the learner back to the next Skool track.
Fill in the `url` for each track: open the track in Skool and copy the address
bar. Paste it verbatim, including https://. Then commit and deploy — the
importer applies them on every deploy, so they survive a database rebuild and
never need re-entering by hand in the admin screens.
You do NOT do the offset yourself. This file says where track N lives; the
importer works out that finishing Riff track N sends the learner to track N+1.
Leave a url blank and that track keeps the safe fallback (the community root)
rather than getting a dead link — so a half-filled file is fine.
`graduation` is where track 8 sends them: the Keys / graduation page. Blank
falls back to the community root.
URLs supplied 2026-09-18. All nine point at the same classroom
what selects the individual lesson, so the links differ only in that value.
Track 1's own URL is recorded for completeness — the chaining never reads it,
since no Riff track returns to track 1.
